sectors.trend: Mixed: gold discoveries (Gateway, King River 44g/t, Moonlight, Auric $28M profit) and coal boom support names, but broad miner sell-off pressures BHP, RIO, FMG. Titanium (McLaren) and antimony (Larvotto) show niche upside.
sectors.implications: Gold miners (GOLD.AX, NGX.AX, AUC.AX) and coal (BHP.AX, WDS.AX) offer relative strength. Diversify away from iron ore exposure. Small-cap explorers (KRV.AX, GWP.AX) attract speculative flows.

sectors.trend: Banks under pressure from rate hike fears, mortgage stress at 18-year highs, and CBA fee scandal. Housing downturn threatens NPLs. Star Group (SGH.AX) management transition adds uncertainty.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face margin pressure from rate cycle peak and housing stress. SGH.AX volatile. Monitor NPL trends and credit costs.

sectors.trend: Oil price jump fuels inflation narrative; coal boom supports Australian thermal coal exporters. Chinese solar overtaking coal is a medium-term structural headwind.
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, AWE.AX benefit from coal strength. Oil-driven inflation raises RBA hawkishness, pressuring equities broadly. LNG names (WDS.AX, GWO.AX) stable.

sectors.trend: Weak: dining chain Chapter 11, kids clothing giant closing 29 stores, small business uncertainty. Per capita recession fears weigh on discretionary spend.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WOW.AX, LSG.AX face soft demand. Defensive staples preferred. Jetstar (JLH.AX) Western Sydney launch is a minor positive.

sectors.trend: Telstra outage (known issue) raises operational risk. Canva privacy legal fight adds governance concern. Global AI theme (Nvidia, Broadcom) remains strong but Iran 'bombs AI bubble' headline adds volatility.
sectors.implications: TLS.AX faces execution risk. CVA (Canva, unlisted) legal overhang. Global AI names (NVDA, AVGO) provide thematic support but geopolitical risk elevated.

sectors.trend: Severely negative: 'Evergrande moment' with mega developer implosion, Bathla near collapse, 10% house price decline forecast, housing 'bloodbath' narrative.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, DGL.AX, ICQ.AX) face occupancy and valuation risk. Property developers (DHG.AX, WBC.AX exposure) at high risk. Avoid speculative property plays.

Housing market correction: 10% price drop forecast, mortgage stress at 18-year highs
Property developer distress: Evergrande-style implosion, Bathla near collapse
Gold sector resilience: multiple WA/Qld discoveries, Auric profit
Coal boom vs solar transition: short-term support, medium-term structural shift
Productivity crisis: 'bad to worse' performance, bureaucratic drag
Geopolitical risk: Iran-AI bubble, Venezuela instability, oil volatility
Industrial action: Qantas strike vote, CFMEU raid

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA 4th rate hike and bond yield spike
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce duration exposure; favour short-duration bonds and dividend-paying equities. Hedge with AUD short positions.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Housing market correction and developer defaults
risk_assessment.mitigation: Avoid property developers and high-leverage REITs. Monitor bank NPL provisions. Underweight CBA.AX, NAB.AX credit exposure.
Monitor QAN.AX closely; avoid positions ahead of potential strike. Diversify away from transport exposure.
Hedge energy exposure; monitor Iran developments. Oil spike raises input costs for consumer sector.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Productivity decline and per capita recession
risk_assessment.mitigation: Favour companies with pricing power and export revenue. Avoid domestic-only consumer names.
Monitor ASIC and APRA responses. CBA.AX may face short-term sentiment hit but limited structural impact.

opportunities.rationale: Multiple high-grade discoveries (Gateway, King River 44g/t, Moonlight), Auric $28M profit, safe-haven demand amid rate uncertainty and geopolitical risk

opportunities.recommendation: Selective coal exposure for short-term trade
opportunities.rationale: Coal boom supports cash flows; Chinese demand resilient despite solar transition narrative
Per capita recession and mortgage stress shift consumer spend to essentials; WES, WOW offer dividend yield and defensive profile
ASIC investigation concluded with no action for Ellison; removes overhang, potential re-rating for MRL.AX

defensive_moves.rationale: Evergrande-style developer implosion, 10% house price decline forecast, 18-year high mortgage stress create systemic risk to property-linked equities

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge rate risk with short AUD / long bonds
defensive_moves.rationale: 4th RBA hike looms, bond yields spiking, growth beat raises hawkish expectations; AUD under pressure

defensive_moves.recommendation: Avoid Qantas ahead of strike vote
defensive_moves.rationale: Ground crews voted for right to strike; operational disruption risk and earnings uncertainty
Per capita recession, retail closures, small business stress signal weak domestic demand

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure over 1-3 months. Rate hike fears, housing correction narrative, and developer distress dominate. Miners and banks lead declines. Gold and coal provide relative outperformance. Qantas strike risk adds volatility. Expect ^AXJO to test lower supports.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 month outlook cautious. Productivity 'bad to worse' and per capita recession cap earnings growth. Housing correction may deepen, pressuring banks and REITs. Gold and energy offer structural support. RBA likely to hold or hike once more before easing. Recovery contingent on housing stabilisation and productivity improvement.
